INSTAGRAM
What an AI developer actually does all day: less sci-fi, more plumbing.

Most of us don't train models. We build pipelines, write and test prompts, run evals and talk to the people who'll use it.
The part nobody mentions: checking the output. Getting AI to work once is easy. Getting it to work reliably is the job.

Questions about the job? Ask in the comments. I'll answer the best ones in a video.
